features.name: Chibi Mode
features.description: Shrinks character sprites into a cute chibi appearance while preserving animations and gameplay.

features.name: Large Kafra
features.description: Enlarges Kafra NPC sprites for improved visibility in crowded areas.

features.name: Giant MVP
features.description: Makes MVP monsters significantly larger to help players locate them quickly during hunts and events.

features.name: Custom Aura
features.description: Adds enhanced aura effects around characters for a more modern visual experience.

features.name: Custom Dispell
features.description: Replaces the default Dispell effect with a cleaner and more noticeable animation.

features.name: Custom Strip
features.description: Provides a custom visual effect when weapon, armor, shield or helmet strip skills are triggered.

features.name: Large Spirit Spheres
features.description: Enlarges Monk and Champion spirit spheres to improve visibility during PvP and WoE.

features.name: @LGP (Light Ground Particles)
features.description: Reduces unnecessary ground particle effects for improved visibility and performance during large battles.

features.name: Castle Arrow Guide
features.description: Displays navigation arrows inside castles and WoE maps to help players learn routes and objectives.

brown.name: Brown Tiles
brown.description: Applies a brown-themed low-distraction ground texture to reduce visual clutter.

black.name: Black Tiles
black.description: Uses dark monochrome tiles to maximize skill visibility during WoE and PvP.

gray.name: Gray Tiles
gray.description: Replaces colorful ground textures with neutral gray tiles for a cleaner battlefield view.

flat.name: Flat Tiles
flat.description: Uses simplified flat textures to provide the clearest possible ground visibility.
